attributes.action: Ensure balanced vehicle access and conservation for Chase Road Brocton
attributes.additional_details: Cannock Chase is a nationally protected AONB and SAC. National Policy requires conservation and access are balanced fairly. Restricting Chase Road Brocton, ST17 0LT - a vital lifeline - would remove essential vehicle access for mobility-impaired people, the elderly, those relying on nature for mental wellbeing, local businesses, emergency services, and residents. This disproportionately affects vulnerable groups, ignoring legal duties.
attributes.background: We ask the government to direct Natural England to review proposals restricting vehicle access to Chase Road Brocton, Cannock Chase. We request changes balance protection with retaining essential access, for disabled/mobility users, emergency services and local communities.

rejection.details:
